items.title: Mike Evans: Expected back after bye week
items.description:
Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Dealing with mild hamstring strain
items.description:
McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Listed as DNP on Monday
items.description:
